children: HF Foods Group terminated its Sales Agreement supporting an at-the-market equity offering program with D.A. Davidson and Roth Capital Partners. The termination, effective Sep 24 2026, also suspends the related prospectus supplement. The move appears to be an early termination; no exit fees were disclosed. Ending the ATM program may reduce future dilution and reflects a shift in financing plans.
